title: Thomas Wanted to See
themeTags: Jesus is not angry at doubt
reflectionQuestion: Jesus was not upset that Thomas had questions -- he simply said, "Come closer." I wonder what question you would most like to bring to God?
kidSafetyNotes: NEW anchor (Easter). Room per Adam = not merely 'questions' but 'Jesus isn't angry when you don't understand.' Protected beats: Thomas 'I want to believe... I just need to see' + Jesus does NOT sigh/scold/'you should have more faith' -> only 'Come closer.' Especially valuable for older kids who start asking hard questions. Wounds shown gently ('the marks on his hands'), no blood/nails detail. Soft close ('Come closer.'). VOICE_REVEREND_MICHAEL_C_VINCENT (pastoral, gentle-welcoming; distinct from Lazarus's John).

scriptureKeyVerse.text: Then he said to Thomas, “Reach here your finger, and see my hands. Reach here your hand, and put it into my side. Don’t be unbelieving, but believing.”
